messages.subject: Re: [EXTERNAL] methylKit and Missing Data
parts:
Hi Louis,

So it was a formatting issue, basically the NA’s in your input files caused the problem. 
If for a certain base you do not have any signal it should be a 0 instead of NA, 
which is also the format that supported software like Bismark would return for missing observations. 

So you have to quick fixes that you can choose from: 
 a) manually remove all rows in your input files that contain NA 
or 
 b) replace all NA with Zeros 

Both will bring your input files in a format supported by methlyKit.

Best,
Alex
